summary: Tested driver tips, admin customer payments/refunds, and Play Store reviewer kit. Backend: new suite test_tips_refunds_reviewer_kit.py 21/21 passed (xdist and sequential runs). Frontend (390x844, external URL): admin sign-in -> admin index shows CUSTOMER PAYMENTS & TIPS + PLAY STORE REVIEWER; payments screen shows tips-by-driver (seeded fake payment: Marcus Reid 2 tips CA$8.00) and rows; refund sheet opens, FULL prefills refundable, over-refund blocked client-side; reviewer screen create shows store/driver credentials once. Customer MD1002 unlock 0101 -> TipDriver card -> square-pay-sheet with $2/$3/$5/Other, totv updates (5.00, custom 7.25). MD1001 unlock 0100 -> OrderPayment CA$22.60 with 'ADD A DRIVER TIP ON THE NEXT SCREEN' hint; hosted page tip $3 -> CA$25.60, tip row shows/hides, email validation works. Real Square charges/refunds NOT attempted (mismatched keys, as instructed). Old test_square_payments.py 5 failures are all Square 401 UNAUTHORIZED from the key mismatch - expected.

minor.issue: Refund lock is released in `finally` BEFORE the refund record is pushed to the stop, and `refundable` is computed from a stop read before taking the lock. Two quick refunds can both pass the over-refund check (Square itself would still cap at the payment total, but local bookkeeping could double count). Move the DB push inside the lock / re-read the stop after take_lock.
tips_total sums tips without subtracting refunds, so a customer whose tip was refunded still sees 'YOU TIPPED CA$X'. Reference: /app/backend/services/realtime.py:62

Square 401 UNAUTHORIZED (merchant config problem) surfaces to the customer as 402 'The card payment didn't go through' - looks like a card decline. Consider mapping UNAUTHORIZED/ACCESS_TOKEN errors to 503 'Card payments are temporarily unavailable' and notifying admin.
No pagination (to_list(2000) stops); fine for now but will grow.

design_issues.screen: Hosted Square order pay page (/api/square/pay kind=order)
issues: At 390px wide the 5 tip buttons (No tip/$2/$3/$5/Other) squeeze 'No tip' onto two lines; consider white-space:nowrap + smaller font or 2 rows.

action_items: Optional: hold the refund lock until the refund record is saved (re-read stop after take_lock) to avoid double-count races
Optional: subtract refunded tip amounts from tips_total shown to the customer
Optional: map Square UNAUTHORIZED config errors to 503 instead of a card-decline 402
Optional: prevent 'No tip' text wrap on the hosted pay page
Note: reviewer driver user has no phipa_consent_given, so Google's reviewer will see the privacy consent modal once after driver login (likely intended; mention in Play Console instructions)

Tip validation is enforced server-side (clean_tip: 0, 0.5, 150 -> 400 verified) - good
tip-link correctly requires the order token of the SAME order (token from MD1001 rejected on MD1002) and returns 409 for non-delivered orders
Reviewer kit GET never returns password/PIN; POST rotates them and old password stops working - verified
